scope: Only exact un-loaded debugger attachment DLL/EXE payloads may have another machine. Candidate owners, Python extensions and actually loaded non-OS providers retain native target checks.

arm64.acceptance_condition: The official source contains no prebuilt attachment PE. Normal Windows ARM64 source build is required; its wheel/RECORD must be validated separately. No foreign-architecture attachment exception is declared for ARM64, and no retagged x64 Python extension is accepted.
